title: 2 Person Cookie Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together
Enjoy with a spoon!

title: ABC Dip
instructions: Mix together, add Miracle Whip until thick
Keep chilled

title: Air Fryer Southwest Egg Rolls

ingredients.name: 1 cup Sour Cream or Greek Yogurt

instructions: In a large bowl, mix Corn-Salt
In a small bowl, whisk egg and water together
Fill the Egg Roll Wrapper with mixture, then brush the edges with the egg wash mixture and fold.
Lightly brush oil on top of each egg roll
Air fry at 375 for 5 minutes. Flip and repeat.
Zesty Dip:
Mix ingredients, store in fridge.
Storage:
Fridge: Air-tight container for 4 days
Freezer: Cool completely, cover with plastic wrap and freeze for 4 hours. Transfer to freezer bag. Keeps for 6 months. Thaw before reheating.
Reheat at 350 for 5 minutes, flipping and repeating.

title: Baja Shrimp Tacos
instructions: Heat pan on medium-high heat with oil.
Mix Shrimp-Flour in pan and cook through, ~6minutes
In separate bowl, mix sour cream-salt and set aside
Assemble on tortilla with desired sides and enjoy

title: Baked Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven 350
Mix all together, make 1 inch balls
Add to baking dish that has a lip to catch drippings
Bake for 30 minutes

title: BBQ Beef Crockpot
instructions: Add all ingredients to crock pot
Cook low 6-8 hours
Shred, cook 1 more hour
Great as burger, or with mashed potatoes and green beans.

title: BBQ Sauce
instructions: Mix all on low heat
Simmer for 20 minutes (should be thin)
Remove from heat & cool (20-30 minutes)
Add to cooked meat
Save in fridge for 1 week or Freezer for 3-4 months

title: Blueberry+Apple Muffin
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 °C. Line a 12-hole muffin tray with paper cases.
Process banana and apple purée in a food processor until smooth. Add canola oil and eggs, pulse to combine.
In a medium bowl, stir flour mixture and banana mixture until combined. Fold in blueberries.
Divide mixture evenly among muffin cups. Bake ~15–18 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Let cool, store in airtight container (last 7 days) or freeze (last up to 3 months).
To Freeze: Wrap individually in plastic wrap.
To Reheat: Sit at room temp for 30-60 minutes OR bake 10-15 minutes at 350
For higher protein: Serve two muffins with a protein shake or Greek yogurt

title: Broccolini with Bacon
instructions: Bring water to boil, add broccolini and bring to boil, cook for 4 minutes and drain
In skillet, cook bacon until done, remove and crumble bacon.
In bacon skillet, ass onion and saute 4 minutes, add S&P
Add broccolini to skillet, turn off heat, and top with bacon crumbles.

title: Brown Sugar Meatloaf
instructions: Preheat oven 350
Mix ingredients all together well
Shape to loaf, put in pan with eging to catch drippings
Cook 1 hour

title: Brown Sugar Pork Loin
instructions: Mix seasoning in a large bag. Add pork to bag and let sit 15 minutes.
Grill on medium-high heat for 20 minutes, rotating every 5 minutes
OR
Bake at 350 for 25 minutes

title: Brown Sugar Pork Loin
instructions: Preheat oven 350
Add oil to skillet and heat to medium-high heat.
Mix S&P, cumin, chili, & cinnamon. Coat pork with it.
Add pork to skillet, browning all sides
Mix sugar, garlic, & hot sauce.
Once pork is browned on each side, remove from heat and coat with brown sugar mix.
Place pork in deep pan, to catch drippings.
Bake 25 minutes. Remove and rest for 10 minutes.

title: Cake Box Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375
Mix all ingredients together
Drop ½ tbsp balls - whatever shape they are they resemble
Cook 9-11 minutes
Let cool
Sprinkle with Powdered Sugar

title: Carrabba’s Bread Dip
instructions: Mix all the seasonings together (red pepper - garlic)
Add 1 tbsp of seasoning to dipping bowl
Add olive oil to bowl to desired amount
Dip bread and enjoy!

title: Cheddar Broccoli Orzo
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add butter until melted, then add Orzo. Cook ~3 minutes, until brown
Add garlic and cook together, ~1 minute
Add broth, bring to boil. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Add broccoli, cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Remove from heat, add remaining cheese and remaining seasonings.

title: Cheese Sticks

ingredients.name: Mozzarella cheese in stick form (Can be block that is cut or

instructions: Heat fryer to 350
Mix flour and cornstarch in one bowl
Mix eggs and water in another bowl
Mix breadcrumbs, garlic, and spices in third bowl.
Dip cheese in flour mix, egg mix, then crumb mix
Fry until golden brown

title: Cheesy Chicken Crockpot
instructions: Season chicken with S&P and garlic powder. Add chicken to crockpot.
Combine cream of chicken and cheddar cheese soups, then pour on top of chicken
Cover and cook low 6-8 hours
Serve on top of pasta, top with parslet

title: Cheesy Tortilla Soup
instructions: In large pot, bring broth to boil
Add ingredients one at time, mixing well and returning to boil after each
Simmer ~25 minutes, until all ingredients mixed
Serve with Red or Blue Doritos

title: Cherry Flan Crockpot
instructions: Spray crockpot with nonstick spray
Beat eggs, sugar, & salt until thick and pale yellow
Add flour, beat until smooth. Add milk and vanilla, beat until smooth.
Pour into crockpot, place cherries on top.
Cover, cook low 4 hours or until flan is set.
Serve warm with whipped cream and/or ice cream.

title: Chicken Caesar salad wrap
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together the chicken, dressing, yogurt, mustard, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Fold in the almonds.
Arrange the chicken salad down the wrap, top with lettuce.

title: Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat large baking pan with cooking spray.
Place chicken between two sheets of wax paper; using a rolling pin, pound the chicken to 1/4-inch thickness.

Place the egg whites in a shallow bowl. In another shallow bowl, combine the bread crumbs with Italian seasoning and salt. Dip the chicken in the egg whites, coating it. Then dip the chicken in the bread crumb mixture, coating well.
Coat large skillet with cooking spray and add oil; heat over medium-high heat. When hot, add the chicken and cook until lightly browned and no longer pink, about 4 minutes per side.
Pour 1/2 cup of sauce into baking dish, add chicken in a single layer, pour remaining sauce over chiekn, sprinkle with cheeses.
Bake for 25 minutes, garnish with basil

title: Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta
Cut chicken into bit size pieces
With oil, fry until golden brown
Add chicken and cheese to pasta

title: Chicken Picadillo
instructions: Heat 2 tsps oil in large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook, breaking up wiht wooden spoon, until browned, about 4 minutes.
Transfer to medium bowl.
Add remaining 2 tsps oil to skillet. Add onion and poblano and cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are golden, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper and cook, stirring constantly, about 30 seconds.
Stir in tomato sauce, raisins, olives, and chicken. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in cilantro and lime juice.

title: Chicken & Stuffing Crockpot
instructions: Combine flour and S&P to large bag. Add chicken and shake to coat.
Melt butter in skillet over medium-low heat, brown chicken on both sides. Add to crockpot, pour soup cans on top
Prepare stuffing according to package, decreasing liquids by half. Add on top of chicken
Cover and cook high 3-4 hours.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup Instant Pot
instructions: Add all ingredients to instant pot in order, without stirring.
Cover and Seal instant pot. Cook high pressure for
8 minutes. When done, let steam naturally release.
Remove chicken and shred, then return to pot.
Serve with rice, make quesadillas, eat alone, or more!

title: Chipotle Chicken Stew Crockpot

ingredients.name: 1 Chipotle Pepper in adobo sauce, minced
1 can Navy Beans, rinsed and drained
1 can Black Beans, rinsed and drained

instructions: Combine all ingredients to crockpot.
Cover and cook low 7-8 hours or high 4 hours
Remove bay leaf. Optional: garnish with cilantro sprigs

title: Cho-Nana Overnight Oats
instructions: Mash half of banana in a medium jar or large glass;
chop other banana half and add to jar with remaining ingredients.
Stir, cover, and
refrigerate overnight;
serve (garnished with fresh banana, optional).

title: Chocolate Bars

ingredients.name: Toppings of choice (nuts, coconut flakes, etc)

instructions: Preheat oven 350
Mix crust ingredients and press on pan, forming even-later base
Pour milk, add chocolate, then evenly layer desired toppings
Bake 25 minutes, or until lightly browned

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375
In one bowl. Mix dry ingredients (flour, soda, salt)
In seperate, bigger bowl mix wet ingredients (remaining ingredients)
Slowly add dry mix to wet mix, combining well
On baking sheet, drop 1 tbsp balls at 1.5 inches apart
Bake 12-14 minutes

title: Chocolate Chip Mug Cake
instructions: Add butter only to mug of choice, microwave untitled melted
Add and mix remaining ingredients from top to bottom
Microwave for 1 minute

title: Cinnamon Apple Chips
instructions: Preheat oven 200. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray
Thinly slice apples
Coat apples with cinnamon and sugar
Bake 2-3 hours
Keep in airtight container, lasts up to 4 days

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350
Mix all ingredients together until well combined.
Add to baking pan
Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until golden brown

title: Cough Syrup
instructions: Add all ingredients to jar with lid.
Tighten lid and shake jar to mix well
Store with lid on in refrigerator
Shake well before taking
1 teaspoon to soothe sore throats and coughs
Repeat every couple hours, as needed
*NO honey for children under 1 years old

title: Crispy Zucchini Coins
instructions: Preheat oven to 450. Coat baking sheet with cooking spray.
Combine bread crumbs, cheese, and pepper in shallow dish
In separate dish, lightly beat egg whites
Dip zucchini in eggs, then coat in breadcrumbs mix.
Place on baking sheet
Bake 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.

title: Crockpot Pot Roast
instructions: Season roast with S&P, add 1 tbsp oil to medium-high heated pan and brown roast on both sides, ~5 minutes each. Then place in crockpot.
Add 1/2 tbsp oil to pan, cook onion, ~2 minutes. Add garlic to onion, ~30 seconds. Add to crockpot.
In pan, add broth, worcestershire, thyme, and rosemary. Scrape brown bits from bottom of pan. Heat to boil.
Add potatoes and carrots to crock pot.
Pour broth from pan on top.
Cook low 8-9 hours
*To thicken sauce (optional), add cornstarch to crock pot after it finishes cooking.
Top with parsley and enjoy!

title: Dakgalbi
instructions: Dice nappa cabbage, green onions, and red onions.
Cut chicken into bit-size slices, mix with brown sugar, gochugaru, black pepper, soy sauce, sesame oil, gochujang, mirin, a curry cube, and minced garlic.
In a pan, spray cooking oil and heat to medium-low heat, cook chicken until cooked through.
Add red onions, nappa cabbage, green onions, and rice cakes. Stir-fry until everything is evenly marinated.
Top with sesame seeds and enjoy!

title: Dirty Rice Crockpot
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet for 8 minutes over medium-high heat, breaking up meat. Place into crockpot
Stir remaining ingredients into crockpot.
Cover and cook low 2 hours

title: Easy Meatloaf
instructions: Preheat oven 350
Mix all ingredients together
Form into loaf, put into baking pan with sides to catch drippings.
Bake 1 hour, or until inside done.

title: Easy Pasta Sauce
instructions: Heat oil over high heat. Saute onions until soften, ~3 minutes. Add garlic, cook 2 minutes.
Add basil - sugar, stir.
Add butter, stir and cook 1 minutes.
Add half of the can of tomatoes, reduce heat to low and stir well, scraping bottom on pan. Add remaining can.
Stir in water. If too thick, add additional water.
Simmer 10 minutes-1 hour.

title: Edamame Tostadas
instructions: Cook edamame to package. Drain and rinse under cool water.
Add edamame to bowl and crush with potato masher.
Add avocado - pepper flakes.
Spread edamame mix on tostada
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, onion, and yogurt. Sprinkle with black pepper

title: Foolproof Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In saucepan, on low heat melt chips, milk, and salt. Stir constantly
Remove from heat, add nuts and vanilla
Spread evenly in square pan lined with wax paper
Chill for 2 hours, or until firm

title: Fried Pork Chops
instructions: In skillet, heat oil on medium-high heat
Mix flour and S&P together in bowl
Trim and rinse pork chops, drying well
Coat pork chops in flour mix well
Fry pork chops ~1 minute each side, or until brown

title: Fried Rice
instructions: In pan, on medium heat add the Oil and Onion, cook until transparent.
Move onion to side, add peas & carrorts, soy sauce and cook until heated.
Move all items in pan to side, add eggs and cook through
Turn off heat and top with green onion

title: Fruit Salsa
instructions: Dice fruit
Top with cinnamon

title: Fruits & Nuts
instructions: In a bowl, combine berries, honey, and cinnamon.
Stir in protein powder- add a splash of milk/water to help mix smoothly.
Top with mixed nuts and optional chia seeds
Enjoy immediately!

title: Gingerbread Crockpot

ingredients.name: Whipped cream, orange peel *Optional, for topping

instructions: Beat butter and sugar, add one at a time egg-salt ingredients.
Stir in hot water and mix well
Coat crockpot with nonstick spray. Pour batter in.
Cover and cook high 3-4 hours
Serve with toppings

title: Green Beans & Bacon
instructions: Steam green beans until soft
Cook bacon
Add all ingredients to pot, cook on medium-high heat until warmed.
This recipe calls for all ingredients to be cooked separately, then combined and heated at the end.

title: Green Beans & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: 1 tsp Thyme Leaves, roughly chopped for topping

instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
Add green beads, cook covered until bright, ~5 minutes
Add mushrooms, cook covered an additional 5 minutes
Add garlic and S&P, cook uncovered for ~2 minutes
Remove from heat, sprinkle with thyme

title: Guacamole Snack
instructions: Chopped veggies into sticks
Serve with guacamole

title: Harissa and yogurt chicken with potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Spray large sheet pan with cooking spray.
Add potatoes to pan, coat with cooking spray and season with salt.
Roast for 15 minutes.
In large bowl, combine the yogurt, mint, cumin, harissa, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Add chicken and coat.
Reduce oven temp to 400°F. Stir the potatoes, ppush to side of pan.
Arrange chicken on pan, spoon remaining sauce on top.
Roast until cooked, about 30-35 minutes.

title: Homemade Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil Potatoes in water until soft.
Drain
Mash & mix in remaining ingredients

title: Honey Ginger Noodles
instructions: Mix Honey-Pepper, set aside
Add oil on medium-high heat
Add noodles and cook for 2 minutes
Add mixture, cook 5 minutes on medium–low
Top with diced green onions

title: Instant Pot  Meatloaf & Potatoes
instructions: - Add meatloaf to top of potatoes
- Seal & pressure cook for 25 minutes. Let naturally release for 10 minutes.
-Once done, open and remove meatloaf, top with sauce.
-Mash the potatoes and add remaining seasonings to them.
Meatloaf:
Combine ingredients in bowl.
Place meat on top of foil and shape into loaf.
Bring foil sides up around loaf
Potatoes:
Peel & dice potatoes into cubes
Place in Instant Pot and add 1 cup chicken broth
Sauce:
Mix all ingredients, Set aside.

title: Japanese Steakhouse Chicken with Veggies and White Sauce
instructions: White Sauce
Mix all ingredients for sauce, set in fridge.
Chicken & Veggies
Season chicken & veggies of choice, then cook in small amount of oil until fully cooked.
Typical Preparation:Chicken in bite-size pieces. Veggies usually broccoli and zucchini but can be anything.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Present oven 350
Brown & drain beef. Cook noodles according to package.
Add tomato paste - black pepper to beef, stir.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
In baking pan, layer: meat, noodle, cottage & mozzarella cheese
Top with parmesan cheese
Bake 45 minutes

title: Lemony chicken francaise
instructions: Place chicken between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound to a 1/4-inch thickness.
Arrange cutlets in a single layer and sprinkle with salt, garlic, and pepper. Sprinkle with flour and rub in.
Place whisked eggs into shallow dish, dip the chicken.
Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set to medium heat.
Add cutlets in a single layer, cook until lightly browned and cooked through.
Whisk stock, wine, lemon juice, and 1 tbsp flour. Add to skillet and bring to boil over medium heat stirring frequently.
Stir in pinch of salt and lemon slices, cook until thicken, about 3 minutes.
Stir in butter.
Add chicken to pan and coat in sauce.
Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Mac & Cheese Crockpot
instructions: In large bowl, toss macaroni with butter. Stir in milk, cheese, S&P.
Add to crockpot, cover and cook high 2-3 hours

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: In saucepan, heat oil on medium-high heat. Add rice and brown.
Add remaining ingredients in slowing and stir well
Boil. Once boiling, bring to low heat and simmer 20 minutes with lid on
Remove from heat, rest 5-10 minutes covered
Fluff and eat
*Cut back for less spice. I do 1/2 chili powder and 1/2 - 1 tsp tomato bouillon.

title: Millionaire Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries, sugar, water and cinnamon stick in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and let simmer 10 minutes. Cool completely (sauce will thicken upon cooling).
Add 1 ½ cups cooled cranberry mixture from step 1 with remaining ingredients and stir well.
Let sit 4 hours or overnight.

title: Mini Turkey Meatloaf
instructions: Preheat oven 425. Spray muffin pan with cooking spray
In skillet, saute onion, pepper, carrot for about 10 minutes.
Once veggies have cooked, place in fridge to cool ~10 minutes
Mix all ingredients together in large bowl (veggies, meat, and remaining items listed)
Add to muffin pan, fill muffin shape. *Place pan underneath muffin pan to catch drippings
Bake 20-25 minutes

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat 350, grease 9” circle pan
Mix sugar and cinnamon, coat quartered biscuits in mix. Add to circle pan.
On stove, melt butter in saucepan on medium-high heat
Add brown sugar, boil 1 minute then pour over biscuits
Bake 35 minutes, cool 10 minutes

title: Monterey Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Grease casserole dish.
In a bowl, mix meat-rotel
Layer:
Tortilla
Mixture
Velveeta
Bake 350 for about 30 minutes, or until cheese melted

title: Mushroom-Beef Stew Crockpot
instructions: Combine everything but noodles into crockpot, stir.
Cover, cook low 8-10 hours
Serve over noodles

title: New Year Cabbage
instructions: Heat oil in pan on medium heat, add butter, cabbage, S&P
On low heat, let simmer for 5 minutes
Add broth, bring to boil then cover and simmer on medium-low for 15 minutes
Raise heat to medium-high, uncover and cook for 5 minutes

title: No Bake Energy Bites
instructions: Mix all together.
Form 1 inch balls
Sit in fridge to firm
Stores up to 1 week

title: Orange Creamsicle Salad
instructions: In a large bowl add the jello powder and boiling water. Whisk it together. Then, add the cold water and stir it in.
Put it in the fridge to cool for about 20 minutes.
Stir in the pudding powder and refrigerate for another 20 minutes until it sets.
Add in the cream cheese and cool whip and stir to combine.
Then stir in the marshmallows and mandarin oranges.
Refrigerate for at least an hour. Serve chilled.

title: Oven Baked Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven 450
Line a baking sheet with foil and cooking spray
Put salmon on sheet, skin-side down
Brush with melted butter
Generously add seasonings
Bake for 12-16 minutes, or until cooked through
Serve with lemon slices and/or dill as garnish

title: Parmesan Asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven 425. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray
Mix oil, salt, and oregano in large bowl. Wash asparagus and dry.
Toss asparagus into oil mix and coat well
Lay flat on baking sheet, bake 10 minutes
Top with parmesan cheese, bake additional 5-8 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350
Mix ingredients one at a time starting at top
Roll into 1 inch balls
Roll in sugar and flatten with fork for criss-cross design OR shape to small patty to top with hershey kiss after baking
Bake 12-15 minutes

title: Penne with Artichokes and Basil
instructions: Heat 2 tsps oil in skillet over medium-high heat.
Add turkey-S&P, using ½ of garlic,, breaking turkey apart and cooking through
Transfer cooked turkey to bowl
Add remaining 2 tsp oil on medium heat
Add artichokes and remaining ½ of garlic, to skillet.
Cover and cook for ~5 minutes, until artichoke cooked
Add pasta and 1/2 cup pasta water to skillet until heated
Add bowl of turkey mix to pasta and cook until 2 minutes
Remove from heat and stir in basil and cheese

title: Pineapple Foster
instructions: Melt butter in medium skillet over medium heat.
Add pineapple until browned, ~8 minutes
Add rum, brown sugar, and cinnamon, cook until sugar dissolved and mixture syrupy, ~2 minutes
Add to ice cream, pancakes, or other dishes as a yummy topping!

title: Pork Katsu Curry
instructions: Pork Katsu:
S&P both sides of pork.
In bowl, add eggs, flour, and water. Add more flour or water until a think but smooth consistency.
Coat the pork chops in the batter, then Panko. Make sure every part of pork chops is coated well.
In pan, add oil and heat. Once hot, add pork chops, frying about 4 minutes each side until golden brown.
Remove cooked pork chops and let rest on paper towel.
Curry:
In pot, drizzle oil and heat to medium-high
Add onion, saute until translucent (~5 minutes)
Add vegetables and saute ~2 minutes
Add 3 cups of water and simmer for 10 minutes on low heat.
Add broken curry mix and stir thoroughly.
Add Pepper and simmer another 10-15 minutes on low heat.

title: Potato & Curry Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add onion
Add ginger and garlic
Add chicken until cooked
Add potatoes and S&P
Add tomatoes and water
Simmer ~20 minutes (potatoes soft)

title: Potato Hash
instructions: Poke & Microwave potatoes until soft, then chop
With skillet on medium heat, add butter
Add remaining ingredients and cook
Add potatoes last, once other veggies are cooked
Cook for 5-10 minutes

title: Quick BBQ Chicken Breast
instructions: Spray grill, preheat to medium fire
In small bowl, make glaze by mixing ketchup-garlic.
In separate bowl or bag, add chicken and paprika-S&P
Add chicken to grill, turning often until cooked (~10 minutes).
Brush glaze on chicken and keep on heat an additional one minute, then remove from heat.

title: Quick Chicken & Dumplings

ingredients.name: You can adjust the amount of biscuits and chicken to your liking

instructions: In a large pot, add chicken broth and bring to boil
Quarter and flour biscuits
When broth boiling, bring heat to medium and add floured biscuits.
Cook for 5-10 minutes, then add chicken.
Cook another 5-10 minutes

title: Quick Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350
In bowl, mix veggies, chicken, and cream of chicken
Slowly mix in milk, stirring and avoid making it runny
Pour mix into one pie crust, top with other pie crust, sealing edges and creating slits on top
Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: Quick Pasta Sauce

ingredients.name: 1 tsp Basil, dried and finely chopped

instructions: In skillet, heat oil on medium heat
Add onion and garlic, cook ~2 minutes
Add remaining ingredients and stir
Simmer on low for 10 minutes

title: Ramen Flavor Mix
instructions: Mix together
Add to ramen or other dishes for a flavor kick.

title: Ramen Soup with Tofu
instructions: Bring broth or soup base and mushrooms to boil in medium saucepan.
Reduce heat and simmer until mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ginger. Add ramen noodles and tofu; simmer until noodles soften, about 3 minutes.
Pour into bowl and sprinkle with scallion. Serve with soy sauce, if desired.

title: Ranch Dressing
instructions: Whisk mayo-pepper together.
Add milk last, gradually until desired consistency
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Store in fridge for up to 10 days

title: Red Potatoes Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 400, coat pan with veg oil
Mix all ingredients together, put in pan
Cook 15-20 minutes, flip and repeat
I like doubling the seasoning!

title: Rosemary Chicken and Roasted Vegetables

ingredients.amount: 1 1/2 pounds, peeled and cut to wedges
ingredients.name: Yukon gold potatoes

instructions: Preheat 425°F, coat raosting pan with cooking spray.
In bowl, combine chicken, vinegar, rosemary, salt, pepper, and garlic. Let stand at roome temperature.
In roating pan, combine potatoes, carrot, and oil; toss to coat. Roast about 25 minutes, until browned.
Coat large skillet with cooking spray, heat pan to medium-high heat.
Add chicken to pan, smooth side down and cook until browned, about 4 minutes, on that one side.
Once roasting pan is done, stir vegetables and add chicken to pan, browned side up.
Add back to oven until chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Bring small saucepan of water t oboil, add peas and boil 2 minutes. Drain water, add salt, pepper, and lemon juice to peas. Garnish with rosemary.

title: Sage Pork Chops
instructions: Mix seasonings together
Rub on pork chops
Cook on skillet or in oven

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Preheat oven 350
Mix all ingredients (Works great in Kitchen Aid)
Form 1 on balls
Add to baking sheet
Bake 20-25 minutes, until meat cooked

title: Sauteed Shrimp in 10 min.
instructions: Have patted-dried shrimp in large bowl. Add seasonings (turmeric-paprika) and mix.
Heat oil/butter in skillet on medium heat. Add shrimp until even layer created, don’t overfill.
Cook 1-2 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Remove from heat.
Squeeze lemon over shrimp and toss to combine.

title: Sesame Turkey Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add pepper & carrot for ~3 minutes.
Add garlic & ginger, cook ~30 seconds.
Add turkey and cook through, ~5 minutes.
Add scallions, cook ~1 minute.
Stir in peas-pepper flakes, cook ~2minues.
Remove from heat and stir in cilantro.
Serve with rice, top with sesame seeds.

title: Sheet-Pan Cheesy Egg-in-a-Hole
instructions: Place sheet pan in over. Preheat to 425°F.
Cut hole in center of each bread slice.
Remove pan from oven, coat with cooking spray.
Arrange bread slices and cutouts on pan, crack one egg into each bread slice.
Sprinkle salt over eggs, cheese over bread cutouts.
Bake 7-10 minutes, until egg whites are set.
Top with black pepper.

title: Snack Plate
instructions: Boil eggs
Grab cheese stick
Heat 1/2 cup edamame
Grab veggies or berries or choice

title: Southwest Vegetable Soup
instructions: In large pot on medium-high heat, bring all ingredients to a boil.
Once boiling, turn back heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 2 hours
Serve with corn bread or rice.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti to box directions
Whisk and set aside eggs & parmesan
Cook bacon
Add garlic to bacon when finished, 1 minute on low heat
Add cooked pasta & remaining ingredients
Add tbsp of pasta water as needed to create creamy consistency

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Preheat oven 350, grease pie pan
Add butter, parmesan, and eggs to cooked spaghetti. Be sure to not make scrambled eggs!
In separate bowl, combine meat and sauce
Form crust in pie pan with spaghetti mix.
Add cottage cheese on top of spaghetti (like the pizza sauce of a pizza)
Top with meat mix in middle
Cook 30-45 minutes
Add mozzarella on top. Cook additional 5 minutes.

title: Streusel Pound Cake Crockpot

ingredients.name: 1 pkg, 16-oz Pound Cake Mix, plus ingredients to prepare mix
Strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, and powdered sugar for topping

instructions: Coat crockpot with nonstick spray
Prepare cake mix according to package
Add remaining ingredients, except berries, to cake mix
Pour batter into crockpot, cover and cook high 3-4 hours
Serve with berries and powdered sugar on top

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400
In large bowl, cream butter and sugar with mixer
Add egg, mix
Add vanilla, mix
In separate bowl, mix baking powder and flour
Slowly add dry mix to wet mix
Roll on floured surface, making dough even and thin
Cut into shapes.
Bake for 7-10 minutes

title: Taco Seasoning Mix
instructions: Mix together and store in airtight container

title: Turkey-Basil Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook noodles and drain according to package
In small bowl, mix broth, soy sauce, and cornstarch
Heat wok on medium-high heat, add oil, turkey, and salt
Transfer turkey to plate, add remaining ingredients except basil to wok. Cook until fragrant and al dente.
Add turkey, noodles to wok until heated. Whisk broth once more, than add to wok and bring to boil until thickened, about 1 minute
Remove from heat and top with basil.

title: Turkey+Cheese Roll-Up

title: Zucchini Boats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. On baking sheet, add foil and cooking spray.
Prep the zucchini by cutting the ends off, slice in half long-ways, scoop pulp from center and save it.
Prep veggies by dicing them into small cubes.
In skillet, cook ground beef and drain.
Add pulp and diced veggies, saute until veggies soften.
Add desired taco seasoning amount. Cook ~2 minutes, remove from heat.
Put zucchini boats on foiled and sprayed baking sheet. Fill boats with beef mix. Top with desired cheese.
Bake 30 minutes

title: Zucchini Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425, line large baking sheet with parchment paper or nonstick foil.
In bowl, mix flour, italian seasoning, & salt.
In another bowl, mix bread crumbs and oil.
In third bowl, mix egg whites and salt, mix until peaks form
Dip zucchini in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs.
Arrange in single layer on sheet, spray with olive oil nonstick cooking spray
Bake about 12 minutes, flipping once. Serve with lemon wedges.
